bounded_contexts.name: Connectivity Requirements
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Connectivity-need identity/lifecycle, required semantic interaction, applicability and justification/provenance.

bounded_contexts.name: Connectivity Decision
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Immutable final Allowed/NotAllowed decision identity, governance scope, validity, reason/provenance and supersession for exact proposed Rule semantic identity.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Authoritative Access Rule identity, uniqueness/idempotency, properties, Active/Inactive and desired-policy projections.

bounded_contexts.name: Authority Management
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Scoped actor/action authority for domain actions by scope/effective time, including Responsibility Assignment, delegation, transfer/revocation and accountability.

bounded_contexts.name: Resource Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Access-domain Resource/Endpoint identity, time-qualified Resource Scope Affiliation, access-relevant lifecycle/affiliation facts and current/historical technical realization.

bounded_contexts.name: Application Communication Catalogue
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Application/Component/Deployment/DCS communication semantics and structural validity.

bounded_contexts.name: Network Enforcement Placement
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Current network-state and override based enforcement-target relevance plus applicable policy/ACL locators.

bounded_contexts.name: Technical Access Evidence
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Normalized source-qualified technical access evidence with provenance/time/source scope and no authorization claim.

bounded_contexts.name: Access Policy Realization
bounded_contexts.responsibility: Effective-policy realization assessment, exact semantic reconciliation, policy-change design, pre-change semantic verification and semantics-preserving target rendering for a given policy target.

invariants: Bounded Context is not a deployment unit.
Connectivity need does not authorize access.
Proposal authority does not imply decision authority.
Resource Scope Affiliation does not imply actor authority, and actor authority for a scope does not imply Resource membership.
Connectivity Decision owns final decision reason, validity and supersession.
Decision expiry or supersession does not silently mutate an existing Access Rule.
Technical evidence does not authorize access.
Access Policy owns authoritative Access Rule identity and operational state.
Network Enforcement Placement owns target relevance; Access Policy Realization does not reevaluate why a target was selected.
Access Policy Realization compares effective policy semantics rather than raw configuration representation.
Technical realization changes do not redefine Rule semantic identity.
